blocks.html: How do I make a payment?
blocks.cls: font-display text-lg lg:text-xl text-ink group-open:text-gold-600 transition-colors

blocks.html: Log in to the AppFolio resident portal to make one-time or recurring payments via bank transfer or credit card. If you need portal access, contact our office at 773.728.0652 or email mirsad@stellarpropertygroup.com.
blocks.cls: pb-8 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed font-light max-w-3xl

blocks.html: How do I submit a maintenance request?
blocks.cls: font-display text-lg lg:text-xl text-ink group-open:text-gold-600 transition-colors

blocks.html: Maintenance requests can be submitted through the AppFolio portal under "Maintenance Requests." For after-hours emergencies (flooding, fire, elevator issues), call 773.728.0652 directly.
blocks.cls: pb-8 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed font-light max-w-3xl

blocks.html: Where can I find my association's governing documents?
blocks.cls: font-display text-lg lg:text-xl text-ink group-open:text-gold-600 transition-colors

blocks.html: Governing documents including bylaws, declarations, and rules are available in the document section of your AppFolio portal. Contact your property manager if you need assistance locating specific documents.
blocks.cls: pb-8 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed font-light max-w-3xl

blocks.html: How do I get access to the resident portal?
blocks.cls: font-display text-lg lg:text-xl text-ink group-open:text-gold-600 transition-colors

blocks.html: New residents receive portal invitations during onboarding. If you haven't received yours or need a new invitation, contact our office and we'll send one to your registered email address within one business day.
blocks.cls: pb-8 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed font-light max-w-3xl

blocks.html: When are board meetings held?
blocks.cls: font-display text-lg lg:text-xl text-ink group-open:text-gold-600 transition-colors

blocks.html: Board meeting schedules vary by community. Check your AppFolio portal for upcoming meeting dates and agendas, or contact your dedicated property manager for the schedule.
blocks.cls: pb-8 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed font-light max-w-3xl

blocks.html: How do I report an emergency?
blocks.cls: font-display text-lg lg:text-xl text-ink group-open:text-gold-600 transition-colors

blocks.html: For life-threatening emergencies, call 911 first. For building emergencies (flooding, fire damage, elevator entrapment), call our 24/7 emergency line at 773.728.0652. A real person will answer and dispatch help.
blocks.cls: pb-8 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed font-light max-w-3xl
